content: jose (npm) is the modern zero-runtime-dependency JWT/JWS/JWK library, tree-shakeable ESM, works across Node/Workers/browser via Web Crypto. It is the lightweight alternative to google-auth-library (which pulls in gaxios, google-auth grpc-adjacent deps) if full JWKS signature verification were ever wanted. Not needed for this project because the hand-rolled flow already qualifies for Google's documented exemption from signature verification (token-endpoint exchange), and decoding a JWT payload is a two-line base64url split with zero crypto needed.
